atlassian.note: OAuth in your agent tool on first use — nothing to store here. Cloud only; self-hosted Data Center clients want `atlassian-self-hosted` instead. /implement uses this automatically to sync a change's linked Jira ticket once a PR is raised.

atlassian-self-hosted.note: Runs locally via uvx (needs uv on PATH: https://astral.sh/uv). Set JIRA_URL, JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN, CONFLUENCE_URL, CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN in your shell/.env — asdlc only writes the ${VAR} references, never the values. /implement uses this automatically to sync a change's linked Jira ticket once a PR is raised.

azure-devops.note: Hosted by Microsoft — no local install. Set AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG to your organization name (the URL embeds it — Azure DevOps doesn't discover the org via OAuth the way Atlassian/GitHub/Slack do here). OAuth in your agent tool on first use. /azure-devops-import and /implement use this automatically to import/sync a linked work item.

azure-devops-local.display: Azure DevOps (Boards & Repos, local via npx)
azure-devops-local.note: Same Azure DevOps Services (cloud) backend as `azure-devops` — this only changes which machine runs the MCP server, not which Azure DevOps you're talking to. There is no on-prem/Azure DevOps Server (TFS) variant of this server; Microsoft has explicitly declined to add one (see microsoft/azure-devops-mcp#993). Runs locally via npx (needs Node.js 20+ on PATH); authenticates via Azure CLI (`az login`) by default — see the docs for other auth options. Prefer `azure-devops` (the hosted server) unless your network blocks arbitrary MCP endpoints or you'd rather reuse an already-authenticated `az` session.

github.note: OAuth in your agent tool on first use. GitHub Enterprise Cloud: swap the url for https://copilot-api.<tenant>.ghe.com/mcp (see docs). /implement uses this automatically to open the PR once a change is verified.

slack.note: A workspace admin must approve the connection once; OAuth in your agent tool after that.
